items.title: GOAL: become the reproducible steward of at least one drifting record inventory (re-verification CI + public status surface)
items.note: Stewardship-not-search: adopt a record surface (bounds/constants/certificates), stand up automated re-fetch + re-verification + drift detection. Extension path if the pattern works: ML benchmark rot (same shape, different records). Source: skylark-site/docs/research-library/2026-07-22-portfolio-verifier-rich-domains.md.
items.closeWhen: One record inventory under automated re-verification with 30-day green CI and at least one externally-acknowledged correction or confirmation.
items.note2: GREEN-STREAK CLOCK RESTARTED 2026-07-24: the 7/23-7/24 greens carried no information — piped CI steps masked exit codes (default runner shell is `bash -e`, no pipefail), so the job was green-by-construction and would never have filed a drift issue. Fixed + guarded 2026-07-24; finding: docs/findings/2026-07-24-drift-alarm-was-never-armed.md. Day 1 of the real streak = 2026-07-24.

items.title: Customer-zero artifact: reconcile the Erdős minimum-overlap constant discrepancy (TTT-Discover 0.380876 vs Tao optimization-constants repo 0.380868)
items.note: 2-week target from lane open (2026-07-22). Determine which value is the current best upper bound and why the two sources differ (superseded result? different problem variant? transcription?). Deliverable: a reconciliation note in-repo with both primary sources cited and the checkable computation reproduced. This doubles as the lane's method template. RESOLVED 2026-07-22 same day: not a conflict - a record sequence (0.380876 TTT-Discover Jan -> 0.380871 TogetherAI -> 0.380868 SimpleTES Apr; Tao table lists all three, re-fetched+verified independently). The stale surface was erdosproblems.com/36 (last edited 1/23, three records behind). Note: docs/reconciliations/2026-07-22-minimum-overlap.md. Spawned W-2 + A-3; curated-vs-live convention adopted (track both, labeled, never blend).
items.closeWhen: Reconciliation note published in-repo with both sources cited and the discrepancy explained.

verifyBy.method: the note's cited sources re-fetch to the claimed values and the reproduced computation runs green

items.title: Stand up re-verification CI for the first adopted record surface (scheduled re-fetch + check + drift alarm)
items.note: Follows A-1 — the reconciliation picks the first surface to adopt (likely Tao's optimization-constants inventory or a subset of erdosproblems.com bounds). CI: scheduled job re-fetches sources, re-runs checks, diffs against the ledger, opens a finding on drift. Public status page comes after the pattern holds, and the public flip is adversarial-review + David-gated. Surface selected 2026-07-22: teorth/optimizationproblems (~85 constants, structure documented in reconciliation #1). CI checks: re-fetch constant files, diff tables vs ledger copy, cross-check external surfaces (erdosproblems.com, Wikipedia, paper abstracts), finding on drift. STOOD UP 2026-07-23: scripts/reverify.mjs (--snapshot/--check) + .github/workflows/reverify.yml (daily cron 09:17 UTC + push + manual; drift -> failed run + auto-filed GitHub issue). Snapshot: 109 files @ a002311. Synthetic-drift demo PASS (scripts/reverify.test.mjs, runs in CI every time, no network). Cross-surface half shipped same day: scripts/check-claims.mjs + ledger/claims.json (7 claims; 6 fetchable HOLD across Tao-at-HEAD + arXiv abs + ar5iv + Wikipedia, C-7 erdosproblems reports UNVERIFIED by design since the site 403s bots). Both checks + both selftests wired into reverify.yml; a failure files one combined finding issue. Remaining for close: green on schedule (30-day streak per G-1). 2026-07-24 — ALARM WAS NOT ACTUALLY ARMED: both live checks piped into `tee` and the GitHub Actions default shell is `bash -e {0}` with no pipefail, so a drift exit-1 was reported as exit 0, the job passed, and `if: failure()` never filed the issue. The synthetic-drift self-test could not catch it (it tested the script's exit code, not the workflow's consumption of it). Fixed with `shell: bash` on both piped steps; reverify.test.mjs now asserts every piped workflow step declares it (negative control performed). Finding: docs/findings/2026-07-24-drift-alarm-was-never-armed.md.
items.closeWhen: CI green on a schedule for one adopted surface with drift detection demonstrated on a synthetic change.

items.title: Haugland-2016 final-digit discrepancy: Tao table 0.380927 vs paper abstract + Wikipedia 0.380926 - candidate first upstream PR
items.note: True value ~0.3809268; determine rounding-choice vs typo by reading arXiv:1609.08000 final section. If typo: a one-character upstream PR to teorth/optimizationproblems = the lane's first outward artifact. OUTWARD: adversarial refute-it review + David sign-off required before submitting. RESOLVED 2026-07-23: NOT a typo - rounding convention. Paper final section gives 0.3809268534330870; Tao rounds to nearest (0.380927, bound-safe), abstract truncates with ellipsis (0.380926...), Wikipedia dropped the ellipsis. Repo is right; no upstream PR. Finding: docs/findings/2026-07-23-haugland-final-digit.md.
items.closeWhen: Determined which value is correct; if repo wrong, upstream PR submitted (after David gate) or finding recorded.

items.title: erdosproblems.com/36 is three records stale - decide whether/how to report upstream
items.note: The most popular Erdos problem index still shows 0.380876 (last edited 2026-01-23), missing TogetherAI + SimpleTES. First: re-verify by hand-browse (site 403s bots; current provenance is agent-fetch only). Reporting upstream (Thomas Bloom) is outward contact: David-gated. Also a candidate demonstration artifact for the ledger's value. STALENESS HAND-CONFIRMED 2026-07-23: David screenshot (via orchestrator reading local disk) shows '0.379005 < c < 0.380876', 0.380868 absent, last edited 23 Jan 2026 - matches our finding exactly. Claim C-7 provenance upgraded from agent-fetch to hand-verified. DECISION FILED: docs/decisions/2026-07-23-A3-erdosproblems-report.md - RECOMMEND report upstream (customer-zero payoff, factual/low-risk), gated on (1) adversarial refute-it review then (2) David outward-send gate; copy-paste draft correction ready in the doc. HELD pending David's gate; no contact made. 2026-07-24 — GATE 1 CLEARED: adversarial refute-it review complete (docs/decisions/2026-07-24-A3-adversarial-review.md), verdict SURVIVES with 2 required amendments — dropped the 0.380871 line (its curated cite [T2026] is a GitHub README not a paper, and naming EinsteinArena points at an unvetted ~0.3808591 leaderboard value, i.e. our own curated-vs-live-never-blend rule broken in our first outward artifact) and reframed the subject as a neutral FYI. Core fact survived all 5 refutation angles; re-verified clean 7/24 (C-1 HOLDS, no mirror drift). GATE 2 (David outward-send) filed as board card 83d32495-7ea4-4586-8342-cd23d0c80f13 (reply-target bounds-ledger; SEND/HOLD/NO-REPORT) — previously there was NO channel carrying this ask to David, which is why it sat. Send condition: if the gate opens after 2026-07-30, re-confirm the page by hand first. 2026-07-24 later — David replied to the gate card asking for a plain-English write-up; delivered as an artifact brief (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/3bfc9310-4c42-4932-9e65-d0a24dbad7fd — what we found / why it matters / who to send to / how sure we are incl. what we did NOT verify / the exact wording / adversarial-review results). Original card 83d32495 went to state 'answered' on his reply, so the still-owed decision was re-filed as NEW card 7b5c90a9 carrying the brief link (amending an answered card buries the ask). Load-bearing honesty line in the brief: we verified the DISAGREEMENT (page vs curated table) but did NOT verify the mathematics behind 0.380868 — the draft claims only the former.
items.closeWhen: Staleness hand-verified AND either reported upstream (post-gate) or a deliberate no-report decision recorded.
